mapper.insert: INSERT INTO draft ( emp_no, user_nm, proj_code, proj_name, gw_code, rent_reason, rent_source, execution_budget, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{emp_no}, #{user_nm}, #{proj_code}, #{proj_name}, #{gw_code}, #{rent_reason}, #{rent_source}, #{execution_budget}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO draft_contract_detail ( draft_id, appr_no, row_no, type, address, address_d, post_code, rsrc_code, area, cont_date_s, cont_date_e, chk_3, accu, deposit_amt, rent_amt, cont_amt, bigo, payment_date, lessor, lessor_name, lessor_account, lessor_bank , cust_code, created_date ) VALUES ( #{draftId}, #{appr_no}, #{rowNo}, #{type}, #{address}, #{addressD}, #{postCode}, #{rsrcCode}, #{area}, #{contDate_s}, #{contDate_e}, #{chk_3}, #{accu}, #{depositAmt}, #{rentAmt}, #{contAmt}, #{bigo}, #{paymentDate}, #{lessor}, #{lessorName}, #{lessorAccount}, #{lessorBank} , #{custCode}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.gw_code, d.mst_seq, d.rent_reason, d.rent_source, d.execution_budget, d.erp_reg, d.cust_reg_attempted, d.created_date, d.updated_date FROM draft d WHERE (d.mst_seq IS NULL OR d.mst_seq = '') AND d.emp_no = #{user_no} ORDER BY d.created_date DESC

SELECT d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.gw_code, d.mst_seq, d.rent_reason, d.rent_source, d.execution_budget, d.erp_reg, d.cust_reg_attempted, d.created_date, d.updated_date FROM draft d WHERE d.mst_seq IS NOT NULL AND d.mst_seq != '' AND d.emp_no = #{user_no} ORDER BY d.updated_date DESC

SELECT d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.gw_code, d.mst_seq, d.rent_reason, d.rent_source, d.execution_budget, d.erp_reg, d.cust_reg_attempted, d.created_date, d.updated_date FROM draft d WHERE d.mst_seq IS NOT NULL AND d.mst_seq != '' AND d.emp_no = #{user_no} ORDER BY d.updated_date DESC

SELECT d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.gw_code, d.mst_seq, d.rent_reason, d.rent_source, d.execution_budget, d.cust_reg_attempted, d.created_date, d.updated_date FROM draft d WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.gw_code, d.mst_seq, d.rent_reason, d.rent_source, d.execution_budget, d.cust_reg_attempted, d.created_date, d.updated_date FROM draft d JOIN draft_contract_detail dcd ON d.id = dcd.draft_id WHERE dcd.appr_no = #{appr_no} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, emp_no, user_nm, proj_code, proj_name, gw_code, mst_seq, rent_reason, rent_source, execution_budget, cust_reg_attempted, created_date, updated_date FROM draft WHERE mst_seq = #{mst_seq} ORDER BY created_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, draft_id as draftId, appr_no, row_no as rowNo, type, address, address_d as addressD, post_code as postCode, rsrc_code as rsrcCode, area, cont_date_s as contDate_s, cont_date_e as contDate_e, chk_3 as chk_3, accu, deposit_amt as depositAmt, rent_amt as rentAmt, cont_amt as contAmt, bigo, payment_date as paymentDate, lessor, lessor_name as lessorName, lessor_account as lessorAccount, lessor_bank as lessorBank, cust_code as custCode, created_date FROM draft_contract_detail WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY row_no
mapper.update: UPDATE draft SET gw_code = #{gw_code}, rent_reason = #{rent_reason}, rent_source = #{rent_source}, execution_budget = #{execution_budget}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT dcd.cust_code FROM draft d INNER JOIN draft_contract_detail dcd ON d.id = dcd.draft_id WHERE d.mst_seq = #{draftId} LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.gw_code, d.mst_seq, d.rent_reason, d.rent_source, d.execution_budget, d.cust_reg_attempted, d.created_date, d.updated_date FROM draft d WHERE d.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE draft SET mst_seq = #{mst_seq}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
